prompt: The cramped attic bedroom at night, seen from a lens fixed high in the corner under the sloped ceiling, looking down at the bed. Brandon lies asleep on his back with the duvet pulled to his chest and a small contented smile on his mouth, his brows relaxed and his eyelids closed. On the cluttered bedside table a phone lies charging on a tangle of cable with one small white light glowing on its edge, beside a mug with a tea ring and a torn packet of biscuits. The room is nearly black apart from a faint orange wash of streetlight from the skylight, the picture is grainy night-mode footage, washed out and compressed. Thanks.
